gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-sarala: Loose, wobbly, hand-drawn fun up top in Shantell Sans. Sarala follows in sans form with distinct gaps in its letters and a thin, glowing line like neon tubing, so a full page of text stays friendly and easy on the eye.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Shantell Sans is all wobble and play, every curve as thick as its straight stems. Sawarabi Gothic settles into a sans-serif body with open curves, so paragraphs of text would glide along quietly.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-shanti: Shanti keeps the text modern, with a generous entry into the e's eye that makes it feel inviting. Shantell Sans is the showier one, drawn at one weight; Shanti is the one to lean on for steady reading.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-shippori-antique: Shantell Sans arrives with a wide-mouthed, pen-drawn personality that grabs attention the second it appears on the page. Shippori Antique is the plain sans that quietly handles everything below it.

Shippori Antique B1 is a modern sans-serif with daylight through every curve. Shantell Sans brings hand-drawn spirit above it, and a long passage in the body would read in one smooth, uncluttered line.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-sn-pro: SN Pro keeps every curve open from start to finish, a modern sans with no fuss, while Shantell Sans above it looks drawn with a round-tipped pen. Its strongest quality is that playful-meets-plain tension.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-snippet: Snippet reads friendly and wiry, its c like a crescent wrench opened wide. The strongest quality here is how Shantell Sans loosens everything up while that plain sans keeps the text grounded.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-sour-gummy: Shantell Sans has a ballpoint-pen stroke that looks scribbled out by hand, loud and a little cheeky. Sour Gummy, a sans-serif with wide gaps, stays crisp even at tiny sizes, so small text is a fine suggestion.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-spinnaker: Shantell Sans is bouncy, its curves matching its stems exactly. Spinnaker keeps its counters open to the outside, so a long passage in the body would feel light and unhurried.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-stick: Expressive from the first letter, Shantell Sans is the one that grabs a glance with its wide mouths. Stick, the plain sans below, does the quiet work with tubelike lines that let light through.
